title: Austin Discusses Jobs, Youth & Gangs
summary:
*   A special community meeting was held to address pressing neighborhood concerns.
*   Discussions centered on unemployment, specifically highlighting job opportunities with upcoming airport construction.
*   Other key social issues covered included housing availability, concerns over gang activity, and improving prospects for local youth.
*   The focused session, held at the Montopolis Recreation Center, lasted one hour.
